title: Morning rush in Philadelphia: every bus and streetcar, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Philadelphia, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus and streetcar inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Philadelphia city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Frequent and Trolley, with Standard in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 584 vehicles at 7:35 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
